summary: ProQR Therapeutics N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited financial statements for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, and a press release announcing Q2 2026 operating and financial results. No special-situation transaction is disclosed; the filing is a routine periodic report and business update by the foreign private issuer. The registrant merely incorporates the information into existing Form F-3 shelf registration statements. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special event. The filing is an ordinary current report under Rule 13a-16, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
